question: Please help me identify the top 3 bowlers who, in the overs where the maximum runs were conceded in each match, gave up the highest number of runs in a single over across all matches. For each of these bowlers, provide the match in which they conceded these maximum runs. Only consider overs that had the most runs conceded within their respective matches, and among these, determine which bowlers conceded the most runs in a single over overall.

WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bs.match_id,
        bs.over_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) as batsman_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    GROUP BY bs.match_id, bs.over_id
),
over_extras AS (
    SELECT 
        er.match_id,
        er.over_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as extra_runs
    FROM extra_runs er
    GROUP BY er.match_id, er.over_id
),
combined_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        o.match_id,
        o.over_id,
        COALESCE(o.batsman_runs, 0) + COALESCE(e.extra_runs, 0) as total_runs
    FROM over_runs o
    LEFT JOIN over_extras e ON o.match_id = e.match_id AND o.over_id = e.over_id
),
max_runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        MAX(total_runs) as max_runs_in_match
    FROM combined_runs
    GROUP BY match_id
),
max_run_overs AS (
    SELECT 
        c.match_id,
        c.over_id,
        c.total_runs
    FROM combined_runs c
    JOIN max_runs_per_match m ON c.match_id = m.match_id AND c.total_runs = m.max_runs_in_match
),
ball_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id,
        b.over_id,
        b.ball_id,
        b.bowler,
        COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0) as runs_on_ball
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id
),
bowler_runs_per_over AS (
    SELECT 
        br.match_id,
        br.over_id,
        br.bowler,
        SUM(br.runs_on_ball) as runs_conceded
    FROM ball_runs br
    GROUP BY br.match_id, br.over_id, br.bowler
),
bowler_runs_in_max_overs AS (
    SELECT 
        brpo.match_id,
        brpo.over_id,
        brpo.bowler,
        brpo.runs_conceded
    FROM bowler_runs_per_over brpo
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM max_run_overs mro 
        WHERE mro.match_id = brpo.match_id AND mro.over_id = brpo.over_id
    )
),
bowler_max_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bowler,
        MAX(runs_conceded) as max_runs
    FROM bowler_runs_in_max_overs
    GROUP BY bowler
),
bowler_best AS (
    SELECT 
        brmo.bowler,
        brmo.match_id,
        brmo.over_id,
        brmo.runs_conceded as max_runs
    FROM bowler_runs_in_max_overs brmo
    JOIN bowler_max_runs bmr ON brmo.bowler = bmr.bowler AND brmo.runs_conceded = bmr.max_runs
),
top_bowlers_ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler,
        bb.match_id,
        bb.over_id,
        bb.max_runs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY bb.max_runs DESC, bb.bowler ASC) as global_rank
    FROM bowler_best bb
)
SELECT 
    tb.bowler,
    p.player_name,
    tb.match_id,
    tb.over_id,
    tb.max_runs
FROM top_bowlers_ranked tb
JOIN player p ON tb.bowler = p.player_id
WHERE tb.global_rank <= 3
ORDER BY tb.global_rank
